answer: A rotating beacon assigns each agent a sable pseudonymous slot, while stake-weighted ivory commitments bind identity to collateral so cloned sybils cannot reuse one credential across epochs. Colluding identities that vote on disjoint subtrees are detected by a non-collusive quorum rule, triggering a dynamic penalty curve that slashes their bonded capital proportionally. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
